description: Takes the people involved (name or role, influence 1 to 5, interest 1 to 5, attitude from opponent to champion, whom each person can bring along, their concern and who on the user's side talks to them) and returns the four fields (manage closely, keep satisfied, keep informed, monitor) with a cadence for each, a numbered conversation plan (win influential advocates first, then neutrals through a bridge person, then critics prepared, then the interested), influential critics without a bridge, people without a contact on the user's side and missing values. Recommends roles instead of names when sharing. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.
